pages.title: Our story
pages.content: A little care. A lot of love. Pawzy brings together everyday essentials for the companions who make life brighter. Explore comfort, play and practical pet care in one place.

pages.title: Pet journal
pages.content:
Keeping pets active daily
Make time for short, supervised play sessions using toys suited to your companion. Rotate their favourites to keep play interesting.

Pet travel made simple
Plan breaks, bring familiar bedding and use a secure carrier or appropriately fitted restraint.

Love and care for pets
Choose suitable accessories, follow care instructions and consult your veterinarian about individual health needs.

pages.title: Shipping & delivery
pages.content: Available delivery methods, prices and estimated delivery times are displayed at checkout for your address. View your order history to follow your purchases. Contact the store if you need help with a delivery.

pages.title: Order & payment
pages.content: Your order total and available payment methods are shown at checkout. Payment confirmation follows the selected provider. View your account order history for updates or contact the store with your order number.

pages.title: Returns & exchanges
pages.content: Please contact the store with your order number to request help with a return or exchange. The store team will explain eligibility and the next steps for your purchase.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.content: We use the information you provide to process orders and support your account. Newsletter subscriptions require consent and can be withdrawn. Contact the store about access to or removal of your personal information.
